text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, the Muses and I are volunteering at a children's hospital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The plan is for them to chat with the children in the courtyard and perform a small concert too. However…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sorry for dropping by all of a sudden, but would you like to talk with us for a little while?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little earlier…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: No way, one of the kids isn't coming?

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately not. This morning, she decided all of a sudden that she doesn't want to leave her room…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Could it be that… she's scared of us? I get antsy about first meetings too…

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text: She was hospitalized only last week for an injury. I expect she's struggling to come to terms with it all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And the loneliness is probably getting to her too, with her being in a hospital so far away from her family.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Dragging her out of her room might only cause her further distress. What would be the best course of action here?

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text: Her parents mentioned that she loves to watch the Beauty Dream Cup. Perhaps that has something to do with it…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um… then, would it be okay if we went to see her in her room? I'd like to try talking with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Guess what, all of us here ran in the Beauty Dream Cup. Did you see us race?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, I saw you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! I'm so happy to hear that. So, what did you think of our running?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Um, I thought your outfits were… No, it's nothing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The little girl clams up before finishing her sentence. It does seem like she has a lot of love for the Muses, though. In that case…
choice_data_list: Why don't we show her your outfits?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You know, that's a lovely idea! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wow! So this is what the Muses' outfits look like in real life!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So, whaddya think? Do we all look cute?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You look like a princess, Curren! And Fine, you're just like a fairy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you fond of fairies? Actually, I'm from the land of fairies.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: The land of fairies?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's right. I come from a country with many beautiful trees and lakes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And for years and years, humans and fairies have lived there together. They do have scuffles sometimes, but they work together just as often.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why, even though it's very far away, the land of fairies—my home country—will always mean a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: …Fine, aren't you lonely being so far away from home?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Aren't you sad that you can't see your mom and dad?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. No, I'm not lonely at all. Because not a day goes by that I don't think about them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Take a look. This dress represents the love I have for my home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can do my best because I know there are people who care about me. They're far away, but everyone back home gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's something we've got in common, isn't it? You're a strong girl too, braving the loneliness of being away from your parents.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: I'm… strong?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You are! ♪ You're very strong, and you're doing your best here.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: I'm strong and… I'm doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: …Um, actually, I really do want to see your concert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, a huge crowd of children comes to see the exciting performance…

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff A
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today. The children look so happy…

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: …Um, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, have you come to see me off?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Um, when I leave the hospital, I'm going to come to your races to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well then, now I really have to run my very best! I can't wait until that day comes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the young girl makes her promise, a huge smile lights up her face. It looks like Fine Motion has really stolen her heart!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy A
text_block_list.text: Nooo, you're leaving already?!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy B
text_block_list.text: Don't go! Sing us one more song!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what a lovely request. ♪ What do you think, Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If it's an encore they want, it's a super-cute encore they'll get! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Muses return to the courtyard for one last performance, and in the end, their visit turns out to be a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Children
text_block_list.text: Thank you all so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What a wonderfully exciting day. Would you mind if we came for another visit sometime?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy A
text_block_list.text: Really?! Is that a promise?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a promise. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, we'll be leaving now. Thank you so much for having us! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The children see the Muses off, and the successful hospital visit comes to an end.
